d: Extremely long, wavy charcoal-brown hair cascades down the back, paired with a mature, adult face featuring narrow, dark eyes and a slight smile. The build is slender, dressed in a long olive-brown overcoat over a white tunic and light-colored trousers, accented by a black scarf with multicolored vertical stripes and golden bead ornaments. A mechanical, silver-toned robotic left arm and hand are fully visible, and the head is partially obscured by a red, white, and black ceremonial mask with horns.
